title: Approximate tangent planes of M along one bi-Lipschitz C¹ chart, off a Borel null set (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.5(2), proof of 1.6 '⇒')
statement: Let P, N ∈ ℕ and let M ⊆ ℝ^P be Borel with H^N(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P (H^N = μHE[N]). Let g : ℝ^N → ℝ^P be C¹, c ∈ ℝ^N, r ∈ ℝ and m > 0 with m|a − b| ≤ |g(a) − g(b)| for all a, b ∈ ball(c, r), and suppose S := g(ball(c, r)) is Borel with H^N(S) < ∞. Then there is a Borel set E ⊆ ℝ^P with H^N(E) = 0 such that for every y ∈ ball(c, r) with g(y) ∈ M and g(y) ∉ E, M has approximate tangent space Dg(y)(ℝ^N) = range(fderiv ℝ g y) at g(y) (SimonGMT HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt N M (g y) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ g y)), Simon Ch. 3, 1.4).
lean_statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid N → Euclid P) (c : Euclid N) (r m : ℝ), MeasurableSet M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[N] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ContDiff ℝ 1 g → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ ball c r, ∀ b ∈ ball c r, m * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖g a - g b‖) → MeasurableSet (g '' ball c r) → μHE[N] (g '' ball c r) ≠ ∞ → ∃ E : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet E ∧ μHE[N] E = 0 ∧ ∀ y ∈ ball c r, g y ∈ M → g y ∉ E → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt N M (g y) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ g y : Euclid N →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))
